analysis:
The PR's only changed line in docs/provider/cli-reference.md is line 52, a documentation edit to the video_url description: it now says inline base64 MP4/QuickTime data URLs are accepted, constant or variable frame rate, with labels in MediaIngest.admittedVideoDataURIHeaders. Line 52 is not in the supplied units (units cover lines 404-1307), so I reviewed the surrounding head text only as context. I found no code, config default, authorization, attestation or crypto change.

I read the unchanged text in the supplied ranges against the threat model. The logout, drain and revoke text matches A-008, T-053 and TB-011: the token is sent only to the recorded issuer, redirects are not followed, and only HTTP 204 confirms revocation. The prefix-cache text matches T-041 and is consistent with its 30-minute TTL, HMAC-keyed names and kill switch. The fan helper (TB-010) and Autopilot text show no new attack surface. Nothing in the supplied lines weakens a mitigation.

The doc line 52 change touches inline video handling (T-050, which covers plaintext video exposure through temp files). The real behavior depends on MediaIngest and the video decode path, which were not supplied. Whether variable-frame-rate support changes temp-file or plaintext handling in the provider cannot be verified from this docs-only patch. The code change, if any, belongs in another PR or batch and should be checked there against T-050 for memory and disk exposure of decrypted video bytes and for resource limits on decode.

No finding is reported. This is a documentation-only change and I claim no full audit.
